scope: Read-only workspace follow-up: Git scope compatibility, long diff expansion, native HTML/PDF preview.

sources.name: rah local reference
sources.adoption: Reference only; no rah runtime dependency or source copied. Reuse repository discovery vs authorized scope separation. Do not copy large Git output allowance, writes or different UI styling.
sources.authorization: Owner authorized local reference; no standalone LICENSE found in sibling checkout.

sources.name: Raft existing official intake
sources.adoption: Directly reuse frozen native modals, sandbox frame and PDF origin check; reuse existing local HTML serving/reporter and isolated PDF gateway. WorkspaceDocument is local data/transport glue, not a copied official workspace document feature.

owners.host: AgentHost root-scoped read; regular private files, symlink/sensitive-path fences unchanged; opt-in channel PDF bounded at5MiB, text1MiB.
owners.git: Read-only Git discovery; repository metadata may be a worktree pointer; status paths converted back to fixed authorized root and filtered. No writes or external diff helpers.
owners.preview: Local gateway session authorization then existing typed Human channel.workspace.read on every read. HTML existing sandbox+reporter; PDF signed exact request,30min expiry, separate listener, authority rechecked on fetch. No artifact publication/comments/index state.

limits: Git diff remains HEAD-to-working-tree combined patch, not per-run provenance;512KiB result ceiling remains. Long text expands4000lines per click after a bounded per-file fetch, not network streaming.
Nested repositories are supported when they are the selected fixed root; no recursive aggregation or repository-discovery picker.

PDF uses bounded full reads, not range streaming; bytes may be read for selection/issuance/view. Browser-native PDF controls/rendering vary; tests prove frame/isolation/valid PDF bytes, not every viewer control.
No Git write, HTML relative-resource serving, workspace comments or new attachment identity. Existing published attachment comment paths unchanged.
No paid provider or cost benchmark.
